title: Share requests with other agents (agent batching)
change: The agent editor has a **Share requests with other agents** switch under **Connection Override** (locale key `agents.batching`). On by default: agents are sent together with other agents in a shared request; turn it off to give that agent its own (slower) request, which helps local models that mix up tasks. Also applies to Prose Guardian, Continuity Checker and Immersive HTML (which otherwise rewrite the reply together). Agents that always run alone show it as off. This contradicts the skill's cost model that each enabled agent is a separate LLM call.
